answer: Run identity issuance as a sealed-bid auction over a fixed ledger supply: each epoch the top bidders take the open slots and losing fees burn. A farm wanting N keys pays the Nth-highest clearing price N times, so its bill climbs quadratically with its share, while one honest agent bids once and earns rebates by attesting peers. An umber audit trail logs every bid, keeping the market no lotus pond; each sybil vertex must outbid itself every round to stay rooted.
